CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation (A) bound to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n3) is identified and an origin/access entry is given, supporting organization/access and a separate status attribute.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified contents' presentation or access; command/estimate labels alone do not qualify.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications name referents and attributes (color) with coordinate values.

D.rationale: Origin/metadata fields separately attribute status/heritage to identified contents, distinguishing content identity from its status/access.

O.rationale: The report states presentation context ('Current...candidate peaks') and includes origin/access entries, describing how contents are organized/presented and their access status.
